body.construction: Expand every supplied \(G\in\mathfrak G\) into its represented DAGs, verify acyclicity, \(\mathcal B\), and \(\operatorname{CI}(D)\subseteq\{c:\mathcal I(c)=1\}\), and verify the supplied lower-bound certificate that no admissible I-map has fewer edges; retain all ties in canonical order.
